LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Enlist_Letter_Label:
Welcome, Recruit. Elder Lyons doesn't ask what you can recover - he asks who you can protect. That's the only Codex that matters here.

You'll draw a standard salary every week for you and your team, along with provisions collected at our holdouts when you're not out in the Wasteland. Our numbers have dwindled, but our resolve hasn't. Fight like it.

 -For the people
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Enlist_Button_Desc: Sign a new contract with the {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Satisfi: You need a minimum of 10 goodwill; currently you have only {0} goodwill.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Missions_Desc: Take on tasks for the {FACTION_name}. Completing a task earns you a bounty reward.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Menu_Missions_Desc: While leaving the holdout you ask around about any potential tasks that need doing.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Salary_Desc: You are entitled to collect wages from this faction every 14 days.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Provisions_Desc: Provisions will arrive via your caravan inventory every 10 days:\n\n- ×5 BoS Food Crate
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Provisions_Desc_Standard_Issue:
Pride standard issue gear will arrive via your caravan inventory every 45 days:

- ×1 BoS Standard Weapon Crate
- ×1 BoS Standard Tech Resource Crate
- ×2 Lyons' Pride Uniform Crate
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Storage_Desc: Store items from your caravan to your faction stash. Faction stashes transfer across all of the faction's outposts and will save contents even if you are no longer enlisted.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Part_Time_Job_Desc: Pull additional duties and cover for your Pride brothers for 10 silver an hour.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Hospital_Desc: Check in with the holdout's hospital. This service tends to all of your team with industrial medicine. Immunity gain is also increased while your team is in the hospital.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Knight_Training_Desc:
Train with the Pride's Knights and Paladins, with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Shooting
- Melee
- Medicine

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Scribe_Training_Desc:
Train in the Citadel's laboratories, with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Crafting
- Intellectual
- Medicine

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Turn_In_Desc: Turn in war prisoners and high value targets to Lyons' Pride holdouts.\n\n -Turning over any hostile pawns does not result in a slavery debuff-
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Resign_Menu_Text: You will resign from the {FACTION_name} effective immediately. (-25 in relations)
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Resign_Button_Label: You have successfully resigned from the {FACTION_name}. (-25 relations)
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Faction: cannot join because you are enlisted with their enemy, {HOSTILEFACTION_name}
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Kick_Out_Label_Title: An order for your contract's immediate termination from service has been filed by {LEADER_nameDef}. You have been kicked out from the {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.FCP_Lyons_Reinforcements_Button_Desc: Call for reinforcements from your faction. The number of Knights, Paladins and Scribes they send depends on your current relations.
